subject: Capacity uplift & secure-silo provisioning ahead of renewal
messages:
From: Samuel Park <sam.park@acme-medical.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-medical.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window: request for two isolated EU clusters + term alignment

Hi Marissa / Stephanie,

Hope you both had a good weekend. Our renewal with Redwood is coming up on 2026-08-15 and our compliance team has flagged a need to move a portion of our production traffic into two fully isolated clusters in the EU region (data residency + enhanced audit trails).

Requirements summary:
- Two additional private clusters (EU) with dedicated tenancy and separate KMS scope
- SOC 2 evidence preserved for these clusters and audit logging forwarded to our SIEM
- Ability to pin model versions for the subset of traffic handling PHI-like telemetry
- Desired provisioning window: 5–7 weeks from signed amendment

We attached the completed security questionnaire and a first-pass site topology for your reference. We will likely want this added to the renewal as a term amendment (aligned start date with 08/15). Can you confirm estimated lead time and whether there is a preferred procurement/PO flow?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short technical sync if helpful.

Samuel Park
Head of Infrastructure Operations
Acme Medical
attachments: [acme-security-questionnaire-signed.pdf, site-topology-draft.vsdx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Park <sam.park@acme-medical.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window: request for two isolated EU clusters + term alignment

Thanks for the detail, Samuel — and for the questionnaire. I reviewed the topology and the ask looks well-scoped. We can absolutely provision two isolated clusters in the EU and surface dedicated audit logs to your SIEM.

Next steps I propose:
- Internal scoping call this week (30–45 min) to confirm network/peering/IP ranges and KMS separation model
- Commercial proposal: term amendment to add two reserved clusters (12-month committed) that start on the renewal date; we will include pro-rated ramp if you want earlier access
- Technical lead (Connor) will confirm provisioning lead time after the scoping call

Can you share the procurement contact (email) and whether Acme prefers a single amendment/PO for the whole renewal + cluster add or separate PO for the new clusters?

I'll loop in Stephanie to draft preliminary pricing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Strategic 
Redwood Inference
attachments: []

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Park <sam.park@acme-medical.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window: request for two isolated EU clusters + term alignment

Samuel — quick commercial note from our side.

We modeled two options to make the uplift predictable:
1) 12-month reserved clusters (recommended) — lower effective $/token and guaranteed capacity. Includes SLA for availability and dedicated support rubric.
2) On-demand burst into dedicated pools — higher unit cost but no long-term commit.

For a baseline, ballpark pricing for two EU clusters (medium profile: 8 x A100-equivalent nodes each) is attached — this includes CPE, monitoring, and the KMS integration support. If you confirm option 1 we'll prepare an amendment that folds into your renewal on 2026-08-15.

We also need Emily Zhao from procurement (cc or email) to accept terms and issue a PO.

Attaching: redwood-cost-estimate-ACM-2026.xlsx

Cheers,
Stephanie
Senior Commercial Operations, Redwood
attachments: [redwood-cost-estimate-ACM-2026.xlsx]

From: Samuel Park <sam.park@acme-medical.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-medical.com>, procurement@acme-medical.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window: request for two isolated EU clusters + term alignment

Thanks Stephanie — option 1 looks like the path we want. Emily Zhao (procurement) is the PO owner — copied above. Emily, for visibility: we'll need a single amendment that includes the two clusters and the adjusted renewal term. We expect the onboarding window to be ~6 weeks after contract signature; please advise if Acme will approve a 12-month commit for the new clusters.

One additional ask: can we get a short canary/proof-of-concept in a non-prod EU cluster before the full migration (just to validate our KMS integration)? That would help accelerate our compliance sign-off.

DocuSign PO placeholder linked here: https://app.docusign.com/ACM-PO-047

Samuel
attachments: [docuSign-PO-ACM-047.pdf]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Park <sam.park@acme-medical.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window: request for two isolated EU clusters + term alignment

Samuel — technical update / feasibility notes: 
- Lead time: with a confirmed PO and a network peering template + IP ranges we can provision two isolated clusters in 5 business weeks (EU region backlog permitting).
- Canary: we can stand up a single non-prod canary cluster within 7–10 business days after we receive the key material and peering config. That cluster will be isolated and can run the KMS integration path you describe.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (bring your own KMS) and can validate rotations in the canary run. For full production clusters we recommend a brief runbook (we'll supply).
- Maintenance windows: please indicate preferred maintenance window(s) in UTC; we prefer to schedule initial provisioning outside your peak hours to minimize rollout risk.

Action items for Acme:
- Provide procurement confirmation (PO / signature)
- Provide IP ranges and peering contacts
- Confirm whether canary should be accessible from your internal VPN or a bastion

I'll coordinate with the infra team once we have the PO.

Connor O'Brien
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: []

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Park <sam.park@acme-medical.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-medical.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window: request for two isolated EU clusters + term alignment

Thanks everyone — summarizing agreed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 
1) Acme (Emily) to confirm PO and sign the single amendment that folds the two reserved EU clusters into the 2026-08-15 renewal (Emily please reply with PO number or attach DocuSign).
2) Acme to share IP ranges + peering contact and confirm preferred maintenance windows (UTC).
3) Redwood (Connor) to provision a non-prod canary within 7–10 business days after key + peering info is received. Full production clusters targeted at 5 business weeks post-signature.
4) Redwood (Stephanie) to circulate the official amendment & pricing sheet for sign-off (we'll include pro-ration language if you want early access).
5) Marissa to own commercial coordination and HubSpot deal update.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood/deals/ACM-2026-047
Please confirm by EOD Friday so we can lock capacity planning for the EU region.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Strategic
Redwood Inference
